answer: Price admission by sponsor load: the bond is k x n^2, where n counts identities already citing the same attestor. A solo agent escrows k into a public crystal that lists every bond. A farm minting 200 clones under one attestor owes k x 40,000, so cost climbs quadratically with headcount while its fable of independence stays a single story. Any peer files an echo of the shared attestor, and a proven collision forfeits all bonds under it, paid to the filer.
